plan.name: Show receipt-bound reader charts on the dashboard
plan.summary: Connect the dashboard's receipt archive loader to the checked reader records and shared native SVG renderer, validating each chart against the model, sibling includes, saved view, lock, bounds and report at that receipt commit, and show the complete rules, unavailable actions, hidden steps, counts and provenance without reconstructing anything from Graph.Compact. Give every modeled project's evidence card an image and a linked script-free evidence page, with a standalone SVG served as image/svg+xml; distinguish no saved reader view, legacy or missing artifacts, snapshot mismatches, generation failures and the explicit over-500-state limitation, preserve raw graphs as separately labeled detail and keep plumbing cards and private action data out of reader presentations. Bind URLs, ETags and persisted cache entries to repository and full project path, receipt commit, reader inputs and complete displayed contents, SVG bytes and renderer format, validate archive companions rather than serving arbitrary archived SVG, and invalidate incompatible or corrupt entries across refresh and restart while retaining valid last-receipt evidence. Add pure README-worded views for all nine qualifying examples (the five two-phase commit variants, three log-buffer variants and connection pool), check their total mappings and hiding using the common reader, inventory all ten examples at unchanged ratified bounds, and require a completed pinned-TLC validation and chart-bearing gate receipts that travel through the archive to visible dashboard charts for every qualifying sibling in this same change; Docker-dependent validation that cannot run locally is Merger work, and the existing CI real Python and TLAPS suites remain required where applicable. Update SPEC.md with recorded decision citations, the README's short linked description, docs/statecharts.md and docs/dashboard.md to describe the completed presentation, limits, example inventory and validation command, and have the merger record the new dashboard presentation and cache policy decision because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestReader631ArchiveToStandaloneSVG
tests.says: An exact receipt archive becomes a modeled project's script-free evidence page and standalone native SVG, preserving the entire checked report and literal labels without a TLC runner or browser renderer.

tests.name: TestReader631DiagnosticsAndBoundaries
tests.says: Charts include 500 reachable states; larger results, absent views, legacy artifacts, failed generation and mismatched archive evidence have distinct visible explanations, while plumbing has no reader chart.

tests.name: TestReader631IdentityRefreshAndRestart
tests.says: Repository, project, commit, source, view, bounds, rules, tools, report and format changes cannot reuse another explanation; valid charts survive restart and obsolete or corrupted cached evidence is not served.

tests.name: TestReader631ExampleViews
tests.says: Every qualifying example and language or synthesized sibling has a pure meaningful saved view at unchanged model and lock bytes; optional pinned-tool validation checks complete exploration, mapping and hiding and carries real chart receipts through the dashboard archive.
